items.briefing:
Scammers are becoming significantly more dangerous thanks to artificial intelligence. Global criminal networks are now using AI tools to run faster, more convincing fraud operations at scale — and Australian organisations, including training providers, are increasingly in the crosshairs. Industry experts speaking at a recent Australian security event stressed that traditional defences are struggling to keep pace, and that smarter, AI-aware approaches are now essential for protecting staff and students.

**Practical tip:** Remind your team to be extra cautious with unexpected emails, messages, or phone calls requesting personal details or payments — AI makes scam attempts far more polished and harder to spot than before.

featured.title: SAS Innovate: New era of scams requires novel solutions
featured.quote: AI-driven fraud is costing Australians billions, requiring urgent coordinated industry solutions.
